companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
As the world of work evolves, Experian is helping shape the future of employer services by combining industry expertise, exceptional service, and client-focused innovation. As a Payroll Tax Associate, you'll join a collaborative, startup-style environment where you'll help grow the business, build strong partnerships, manage important priorities, and bring new ideas that drive better results.

You will report to our Manager, Payroll Tax Consulting, work remotely and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs:

Costa Mesa, CA, San Jose, CA, Allen, TX, Austin, TX, Franklin, TN, New York, NY, Schaumberg, IL, Washington, D.C., Atlanta, GA, Boston, MA, Seattle, WA

 

You are:

Collaborative – Partner with fellow team members, peers, and able to connect ideas across internal and external opportunities

Creative and Curious – Challenge traditional approaches, inquisitive with a fondness for looking for new opportunities

Determined and Disciplined – Optimistic about what can be, persistent, looks for high levels of activity, expresses a fierce commitment to challenging status quo.

What you will do:

  • Collaborate on a multi-year strategic initiative to grow a new business.
  • Partner with leadership to manage important client relationships.
  • Lead client projects, including task management, file organization, deadlines, and billing.
  • Provide payroll tax consulting and guidance, helping clients improve processes and identify potential tax refunds.
  • Support M&A activities, reporting requirements, tax savings opportunities, and federal and state audits.
  • Work with federal, state, and local taxing authorities to resolve client matters and manage tax risk.
  • Support leadership with research, publications, and presentations.
  • Learn new concepts and contribute to the development of a growing business.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Relevant payroll tax consulting experience.
  • Proficient in Microsoft suite of products, especially Excel spreadsheets.
  • Experience managing client tax deadlines.
  • Experience analyzing payroll data, client workpapers, and tax forms.
  • Comfortable with tax legislation, IRS rules/regulations, and general tax research.
